decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the core distributed portfolio and costs little to hold, and no negative signal has appeared yet, so the option stays open.

The UV spot varnishing flagship is distant from the core and still uncertain, but two years after its German premiere it is too early to judge its value, and keeping it gives the firm a cheap foothold in print enhancement.
The sheet preparation module is a low-cost complementary add-on to the established systems with no evidence against it, so keeping it open is justified.
The B2 multifinisher is a core-aligned flagship supporting the firm's automation direction, which warrants continued commitment.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the core booklet-making business and has low holding costs, and its prospects are not yet resolved, so it is kept.
